principles: Verify actual merged code before publication

options.name: Normal merge with intent-based conflict resolution
pros: Preserves both histories and independent improvements
cons: Requires resolving conflicting versions and verifying combined semantics

options.name: Reapply only local commits on remote
cons: Rewrites local integration history and may lose completed Story lineage

chosen: Normal merge with intent-based conflict resolution
rationale: The user selected integration; a true merge preserves completed local Story lineage and remote improvements while allowing explicit conflict resolution.

preMortem.scenario: Blind local selection drops remote receipt safeguards
preMortem.mitigation: Preserve remote provenance/context logic and run both selector negative checks.

preMortem.scenario: Inconsistent package versions break runtime binding
preMortem.trigger: Version conflict across five synchronized paths
preMortem.consequence: CLI build or compatibility validation fails
preMortem.mitigation: Keep remote0.3.278 consistently and verify build/version contract.

preMortem.scenario: Remote changes after integration invalidate fast-forward
preMortem.consequence: Push rejection or lost remote commits if forced
preMortem.mitigation: Fetch immediately before publication and never force-push; re-integrate new commits if needed.
